sloka: विमुक्तकवचस्तत्र वध्यमानो ऽपि रावणिः ।त्रिदशैः सुमहावीर्यैर्न चकार च किञ्चन ।। ७.२९.२५ ॥
transliteration: vimuktakavacastatra vadhyamāno 'pi rāvaṇiḥ ।tridaśaiḥ sumahāvīryairna cakāra ca kiñcana ।। 7.29.25 ॥

translations.english: Even though Indrajit was without armor and being struck there by the exceedingly valiant gods, he did not suffer any harm.
